title: Contract balance from revenue and billing

company.company_business: IT implementation and managed services for mid-size Indian businesses

narrative_template:
On its contract with {customer}, Kalmira has recognised revenue of ₹{revenue_to_date} to date and billed ₹{billed_to_date} under the milestone schedule. What is the contract balance at 31 March 2026? Give a positive amount for a contract asset and a negative amount for a contract liability.

Round amounts to the nearest rupee and percentages to one decimal place. All names are fictional.

rubric.text: Contract balance = revenue to date - billed to date.

explanation: Contract balance = revenue to date - billing to date = ₹{contract_balance} (paras 105-107).

mistakes.feedback: The sign is the wrong way round. When revenue is ahead of billing, the excess is a contract asset (positive); when billing is ahead, a contract liability (negative).
